text_block_list.text:
One day, while discussing Hishi
Amazon's training
with her, I can't help
but notice something...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Urk... You sure know how to read me,
Teach.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Truth is, everyone in the dorm is gettin'
together
for a fright night. They asked
me to make them
ghost costumes.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad they like my sewing skills so
much, but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'm not exactly jazzed about having to
watch a
horror film, even if it's for the
sake of gathering
costume references...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, and wh-what's it to you?!
Everyone's got
their weaknesses!
choice_data_list_en: You can't handle horror, can you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I can handle earthquakes, thunder, fires,
creepy
old guys—you name it. But
ghosts... I can't do
ghosts!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Would you?! You'd be doing me a huge favor, Teach!
choice_data_list_en: ...Want me to watch it with you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
It'd be pointless watching the movie for
reference
if I just get spooked and look
away from the
screen whenever things
get scary.

And so, we watch a horror movie in my
office. To
stimulate the feel of a fright
night, I keep the
lights off.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Um, Teach... any ideas when the
ghosts're gonna
show up?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I keep bracin' myself for the next jump
scare, but
at this rate, not even my
nerves of steel're gonna
be able to hold
out!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... What a cheap way of doing
things. They
should stop delayin' it and
just jump out alrea—
choice_data_list: ホラーってそういうものだから……
choice_data_list_en: That's just how horror works, after all...

text_block_list.name: Movie Ghost
text_block_list.text: RAAAGH!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: EEEEEK!

text_block_list.name: Movie Victim
text_block_list.text: Arrrrgghh!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
They got him... just like that! He didn't
even stand
a chance!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Teach... I'm done! I know this was for the

costumes, but I just can't go on.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You can't one-on-one a ghost! None of
your hits
would land!

Hishi Amazon's nerves are beyond
frayed... But at
this rate, she won't be
able to get any costume
references. How
can we overcome this?

Hishi Amazon's nerves are beyond
frayed... But at
this rate, she won't be
able to get any costume
references. How
can we overcome this?
choice_data_list: タイマン張れたらいいんだな？
タイマン張れたらいいんだね？
choice_data_list_en: You just want to go one-on-one, right?
You just want to go one-on-one, right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah. I could easily come out on
top with a
good punch and kick!
choice_data_list: タイマン張れたらいいんだな？
タイマン張れたらいいんだね？
choice_data_list_en: You just want to go one-on-one, right?
You just want to go one-on-one, right?

text_block_list.text:
Working off that idea, I instead suggest
we watch
some films where the enemies
are susceptible to
physical damage.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hm, yeah! That's a great idea! I like it!
So what do
you recommend, Teach?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what's so different about that one?!
Choose
something else, please!
choice_data_list: まず、今観ている映画のリメイク作
choice_data_list_en: First, the remake of the movie we're watching now.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
That does sound like a fair bit of
scrappin' would
be going on. But aren't
the enemies just regular
ol' thugs?! I
need references for ghosts!
choice_data_list: なら、荒廃した世界でのバトル映画
choice_data_list_en: Then, how about an action movie set in a wasteland?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good! You can definitely clock a
mummy
in the face and take 'em down,
and that's just
enough horror for me!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
We should have watched this from the
start.
You're pretty smart, Teach.
I accept her compliment and show her the cover of the movie Umamusume vs. Mummy.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
What's with this mummy? Its bandages
are
practically fallin' off. How sloppy.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
My costumes won't have this
problem—I'll make
sure the bandages
are wrapped so tightly they're

practically skintight!

...Costume criticisms aside, it looks like
Hishi
Amazon is back to her normal self.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
What! Are you telling me to abandon
you and run
off with my tail tucked
between my legs?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm not doing that! If it's gonna
come down
to that, uh...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'd rather get over my fear of
ghosts! Let
me show you what it means
to have guts!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah, sure. I won't.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yep, they're fine! As long as you're
good, Teach.
choice_data_list: 音量や暗さはこのままで平気？
choice_data_list_en: Are the volume and darkness okay like this?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hm... Nah, I'm good...
choice_data_list_en: Do you need a drink or anything?

text_block_list.text:
We watch the horror movie to the very
end.
However...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Heh, hehehe! Teach!
Thud!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I-I'm feeling a little weak in the knees...

Hishi Amazon experiences firsthand just
how hard
overcoming your fears is...
